description: Draft a cover letter from the user's resume and the job posting with fixed rules: name, contact details and up to two results from the resume, the job title and top keywords from the posting. Facts that are missing show as [square-bracket] gaps for the user to fill, never as stand-ins. Returns the letter, the gaps and a checklist.

company.description: Optional. The company they are applying to.

current_title.description: Optional. The user's current or last job title.

hiring_manager.description: Optional. The hiring manager's name, if known.

job_description.description: The full job posting as plain text, including its requirements (120–20,000 characters). For a link, call fetch_job_post first.

name.description: Optional. Overrides the name read from the resume.

results.description: Optional. One or two real results, one per line.

resume_text.description: The whole resume as plain text, one heading, role or bullet per line.

role.description: Optional. The job title they are applying for.

why.description: Optional. Why this company, in the user's words.

name: draft_cover_letter
title: Draft a cover letter
